name: repackshot
description: A clean-room, MIT-licensed, browser-based 3D product renderer.

scripts.qa: npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.engine:build: cargo build --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -p rt-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && mkdir -p public/engine && cp engine/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/rt_wasm.wasm public/engine/rt.wasm
